newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzanian shilling down on dollar and pound.
newsitem.headline: Tanzanian shilling down on dollar and pound.

text.p: The Tanzanian shilling depreciated against the dollar and pound on Monday but traders took the news in their stride.
Against the dollar the local shilling exchanged at a commercial mean rate of 599.5440 compared to Friday's 599.3559 and at 975.9408 versus the pound compared to Friday's 966.7879.
Traders said the depreciation is expected in the run up to the June budget as importers stock up on goods depleted over Christmas and the Moslem Ramadan holidays.
